body_markdown:
Looking for your next weekend binge, movie night pick, or big game?


TDS TV+ customers who subscribe to Paramount+ with Showtime now get **Paramount+ Premium included at no additional cost** .


That means your subscription doesn’t end with the premium channels you watch directly on your TV through TDS TV+. You can also take your entertainment on the go and stream the Paramount+ library on your smartphone, laptop, or tablet.


There’s plenty of great content to add to your watch list. Catch up on hits including *Tulsa King* , *Landman* , *Dutton Ranch* , and *Sherrif County* , then get ready for even more.


***Dexter: Resurrection*** ***Season 2*** just kicked off on Friday, Oct. 30, where Dexter Morgan finds himself caught between two killers – one notorious and the other terrorizing New York in ways no one ever anticipated – all while battling his greatest enemy yet: a mid-life crisis.


Then, on Friday, Nov. 20, the series finale of ***Yellowjackets*** begins, where the survivors of flight 2525 race to bury their sins before rescue arrives — but the Wilderness has its own ideas about who gets out alive.


And it’s not just must-watch series. From a cozy holiday movie weekend to NFL action on CBS, Paramount+ Premium gives you even more ways to find something worth watching.


**Ready to start streaming?**


If you already subscribe to Paramount+ with Showtime through TDS, activating your included Paramount+ Premium access is quick and easy:


1. Visit ParamountPlus.com/link and select **TDS** under “More Providers.”
2. Sign in with your TDS My Account credentials.
3. Create your Paramount+ account or profile if prompted.
4. Start streaming!


Don’t have Paramount+ with SHOWTIME yet? TDS TV+ customers can add it to their TV package for $13.99 per month, opening the door to both premium TV channels and the complete Paramount+ Premium streaming experience. Customers in Arizona, Colorado, Nevada, New Mexico, North Carolina, and Utah can[click here](https://shop.hellotds.com/tv/tdstv-plus.html) for more information, while all other customers can[browse TV options here](https://tdstelecom.com/shop/tv/tdstv-plus.html) .


Whether you’re settling in on the couch or streaming away from home, your next favorite, movie, or matchup is waiting.
